rule_description: Every record must identify its source system
Amounts must be non-negative except S.B.5 Counterparty Netting and S.B.6 Carrying Value Adjustment (p.73)
fail_predicate: source_product_code NOT IN (SELECT source_product_code FROM {catalog}.reference.v_source_product_map WHERE standard_product_type IN ('CPTY-NETTING','CARRY-ADJ')) AND (COALESCE(principal_amount,0) < 0 OR COALESCE(market_value,0) < 0 OR COALESCE(collateral_value,0) < 0 OR COALESCE(lendable_value,0) < 0)

rule_description: Source products that carry collateral must identify it: a security id, linked collateral or generic substitution terms (the Collateral Class is derived from them)
fail_predicate: collateral_id IS NULL AND generic_issuer_type IS NULL AND source_product_code IN (SELECT source_product_code FROM {catalog}.reference.v_source_product_map m JOIN {catalog}.reference.ref_standard_product_type t USING (standard_product_type) WHERE t.requires_collateral) AND record_id NOT IN (SELECT record_id FROM {catalog}.raw.collateral_links l WHERE l.as_of_date = '{as_of}')

rule_description: A DATED instrument must mature after the as-of date
customer_id must be a customer the bank has onboarded (KYC extract); onboarded customers awaiting classification are held by notebook 03, not quarantined
fail_predicate: customer_id IS NOT NULL AND customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM {catalog}.reference.v_customer_master) AND customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM {catalog}.raw.customers c WHERE c.as_of_date = '{as_of}')

rule_description: source_product_code must map to a standard product type (initial map or an approved new code) - it drives the PID derivation
fail_predicate: source_product_code IS NULL OR source_product_code NOT IN (SELECT source_product_code FROM {catalog}.reference.v_source_product_map)

rule_description: collateral_id must exist in the security master (Appendix III Collateral Class)
fail_predicate: collateral_id IS NOT NULL AND collateral_id NOT IN (SELECT collateral_id FROM {catalog}.reference.ref_security_master)

rule_description: Demand deposit accounts are payable on demand and should be Open
fail_predicate: source_product_code IN (SELECT source_product_code FROM {catalog}.reference.v_source_product_map WHERE standard_product_type = 'DDA') AND maturity_type <> 'OPEN'

rule_description: Every record must be booked in one of the group's legal entities
fail_predicate: booking_entity IS NULL OR booking_entity NOT IN (SELECT legal_entity_id FROM {catalog}.reference.ref_legal_entity)

rule_description: record_id must be unique per as-of date (duplicates are collapsed to one record)
fail_predicate: record_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM v_dq_staging GROUP BY record_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

rule_description: Currency must have an FX rate for conversion (Field Definitions p.16)
fail_predicate: currency IS NULL OR currency NOT IN (SELECT currency_code FROM {catalog}.reference.ref_fx_rates) OR (currency_2 IS NOT NULL AND currency_2 NOT IN (SELECT currency_code FROM {catalog}.reference.ref_fx_rates))

rule_description: Standard product types that need a counterparty must carry a customer_id
fail_predicate: customer_id IS NULL AND source_product_code IN (SELECT source_product_code FROM {catalog}.reference.v_source_product_map m JOIN {catalog}.reference.ref_standard_product_type t USING (standard_product_type) WHERE t.requires_customer)
